dashboardIntro1:
This unique piece of software
    supports the analysis, implementation and management of
    Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) and has been developed by
    CSRC International Ltd. It follows the structure of the ISO 26000 standard
    (the international standard on social responsibility), focusing on its seven
    core subjects. It aims to provide a comprehensive analysis of the status of
    CSR activities within each organisation, thereby supporting the development of a
    professional CSR strategy and facilitating engagement of your stakeholders.
dashboardIntro2:
While companies are not responsible for solving the problems of society,
    they are certainly responsible for addressing the problems they cause or
    create. The 7 Toolkit is made for such companies, which cannot
    run the risk of poor CSR management practices and who face rigorous expectations
    from stakeholders. It includes a set of questions to help evaluate the existing
    management practices in your organisation in relation to actions taken and
    expectations, to determine how socially responsible you are and what you can do to
    improve.
dashboardIntro3:
The importance of CSR is reflected in the EU’s strategy on CSR (2011-2014) and the
    EU Directive 2014/95/EU on the disclosure of non-financial and diversity information
     by certain large undertakings and groups. Furthermore, by evaluating how socially
     responsible you are using this toolkit, we can help you comply with other international
     standards and conventions on sustainability, such as the Global Reporting Initiative’s
     (GRI) G4 guidelines on sustainability reporting, the German Sustainability Codex, the
      United Nations Global Compact (UNGC), the OECD guidelines for multinational enterprises,
       the United Nations Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights and more.
